name: moneylens
description: Turn financial emails and statements into a local spending report covering spending, money in and transfers.

interface.longDescription:
MoneyLens turns your bank and card emails into a clear picture of your money. Bring statements and transaction alerts together in one spending report, see where your money goes, and track money in and transfers.

Explore spending by category, correct merchant categories, and keep the same report up to date with daily refreshes where supported. MoneyLens matches alerts against statements, keeps confirmed and provisional activity distinct, and highlights anything that needs your review.

You choose the email accounts to use. Your ledger and report are saved locally; your AI host and email connector process the source content used to build and update them.

Coverage depends on the emails and statements available. Check unresolved items and the original sources before relying on a total.

MoneyLens is a reporting tool, not financial, investment, tax or legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Set up MoneyLens and my daily spending report.
